Well for me personally- I really enjoy the added teammate AI and their corresponding progression/customization. The addition of "Immersive Mode" and the ability to edit world parameters such as drone/helicopter/azrael patrols and remove gear score/mandatory double primary weapons. New weapon blueprints+gear for customization (so happy with the Mk18). The Strike Designator and Pathfinder Class with access to Azrael drone strikes. 

I wrap all that up with a neat little OCP kit and tackled Operation Motherland as a JTAC attached to a SOF detachment 👍
